$comment: Permission matrix for the PyArcana supervisor / cohort system. Generated by product_hardening Phase 2. The matrix is the single source of truth consulted by src/lib/permissions.ts at runtime. Default deny: any (role, action) pair not listed here is denied.

STUDENT.description: Default role for every signed-up user. Can use the LMS as a learner; cannot supervise or administer.

ADMIN.description: Site-wide administrator. Provisioned out-of-band per phase0_reality_report.md Q1. ADMIN is a superset of every other role's permissions.

SUPERVISOR_ENABLED.description: Global flag indicating the user has an approved SupervisorProfile. Not a standalone role — it is a flag that complements STUDENT. A user with this flag has the global permission to create cohorts within their entitlement.

COHORT_OWNER.description: The user who created the cohort (or to whom ownership was transferred). Has full management of the cohort.

COHORT_SUPERVISOR.description: A co-supervisor. Promoted from COHORT_LEARNER by the owner. Can view and download but cannot manage membership.

COHORT_REPORTER.description: Read-only role. Useful for HR or stakeholders who need to see progress without managing anything. Does not require a Pro or Team subscription.

COHORT_LEARNER.description: Default role for a member who accepted an invitation. Can view their own progress within the cohort context and leave.

actionDefaults.$comment: Any (role, action) pair not explicitly listed in globalRoles[].permissions or cohortScopedRoles[].permissions is DENY. The src/lib/permissions.ts helper consults this matrix; if a role-action pair is missing, the helper throws PermissionDeniedError.

explicitlyDenied.$comment: These actions are DENY for every role except ADMIN. They are listed here for documentation; the runtime does not need to consult this list (default deny covers it).

roleCombinationRules.$comment: Rules for combining global and cohort-scoped roles. The effective permission set for an action is the union of permissions granted by (a) the user's global roles and (b) the user's cohort-scoped role for the target cohort.
roleCombinationRules.$comment_globalOverridesScoped: Global ADMIN does NOT inherit cohort-scoped roles; instead, ADMIN has explicit cohort:* permissions via the admin namespace. The runtime checks ADMIN first as a special case.
roleCombinationRules.$comment_adminBypass: ADMIN bypasses all cohort-scoped role checks. The runtime consults the cohort-scoped matrix only for non-ADMIN users.
roleCombinationRules.multipleCohorts: A user may be a member of multiple cohorts with different scoped roles. Permission checks are per-cohort; role in cohort A does not grant any permission in cohort B.
roleCombinationRules.suspendedSupervisor: If SupervisorProfile.status === 'SUSPENDED', the user retains existing cohort-scoped roles (so they can still view) but loses the global 'supervisor:create_cohort' and 'supervisor:request_entitlement_upgrade' permissions, and loses 'cohort:invite_learner' on all owned cohorts.

entitlementEnforcement.$comment: Entitlement limits enforced at runtime by src/lib/permissions.ts and the cohort API routes.

rateLimits.$comment: In-memory token bucket per server instance. Documented limitation: serverless cold starts reset the bucket.

staticSiteGuard.$comment: When IS_STATIC_SITE === true (per src/lib/runtime-mode.ts), all supervisor / cohort / invitation / notification / report endpoints return 404. The UI does not render supervisor surfaces.
